• GARAGE FIX: one 11'-wide bay now runs nearly the full 24' depth; east window adds shop daylight without sacrificing vehicle length.
• STACKED CORE: level-2 bath aligns over a level-1 powder room; W/D opens directly to circulation beside the wet core.
• FIRE / AIR: protected hall replaces the garage-to-sunroom slider; architect to specify rated separation, protected door, and sealed penetrations.
• KITCHEN FIX: L-shaped peninsula kitchen replaces island; main route is 53.6 in clear, with no separate TV wall.
• ENTRY / PATIO: stair landing continues around the SE corner to a full east patio; large sliders serve both living and garden room.
• WINDOWS: west bedroom casement to meet final EERO clear opening; enlarged south living + east dining glazing; north wall remains solid.
• ZONING HOLD: owner office/garden room and lower bath are not assumed to be ADU floor area; obtain written classification before permitting.
• SECTION HOLD: verify 20' height cap, sloped-ceiling headroom, 14-riser stair, guards, structure, drainage, MEP, and all dimensions.
